**Exploring screenshot options**

I need to figure out how the screenshot function works. It seems like it takes a name and an optional pixel ratio. I wonder if it captures the full screen or just a specific part of the app. The requirements mention relevant settings for the region, so I'm thinking about how drive.py might handle screenshots specifically in the repaint boundary. I should definitely check out the debug_hooks boundary in main.dart and look into the screenshot methods in dev/agent_service.dart.
